result.topic_en: Draft notes on a natural-philosophical model in which forces at each point of space are explained as causes (accelerating forces) producing motions of ponderable points, and in which light and heat propagation are explained by the motion of a space-filling substance whose volume elements change shape and size under forces.

items.english: From this it can easily be shown that in such a motion the same amount of substance always occupies the same space.

items.english: So one must assume that it constantly makes the substance vanish in a measure proportional to its attractive force.

items.english: On this view, the propagation of light and heat radiation through space free of ponderable bodies must likewise be explained by motions of the substance.
